items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well just before we started here you were talking about some of your early gigs with a good friend of Hamilton actually, Bucky Pizzarelli.

ctx.x: Well you would think I could really club them with this, wouldn’t you? But this is from a store that went out of business in New York called Professional Percussion. And one of the fellas who worked there was taking lessons with me so he brought me — I don’t know what happened to the other one, maybe I broke it on somebody.
Well just before we started here you were talking about some of your early gigs with a good friend of Hamilton actually, Bucky Pizzarelli. He’s been up to the college a number of times.
